notes: Better language detection on POST /api/reviews: instead of guessing the language purely from the submitter's IP-derived country, it now checks (in order) an explicit 'lang' field from the frontend (trusted since only the frontend knows which language page the visitor is actually on - ignored if it doesn't name a real active language), then the browser's Accept-Language header, then falls back to IP-derived country same as before. Country itself is still always geolocated, never taken from the caller. No database changes.
